description: This header file defines the SystemDelegate class, which manages system-related operations and event subscriptions within a Thunder/JSON-RPC based environment. It provides methods to get/set device info, handle HDR, HDCP, resolution, audio, and system name, and manages subscriptions to Thunder plugin events.

classes.name: SystemDelegate
classes.description: A class that manages system information retrieval, event subscriptions, and event dispatching for device system events via Thunder/JSON-RPC interfaces.

methods.name: GetDeviceMake
methods.description: Retrieves the device manufacturer information via 'org.rdk.System.getDeviceInfo'.

methods.name: GetDeviceName
methods.description: Retrieves the device friendly name via 'org.rdk.System.getFriendlyName'.

methods.name: SetDeviceName
methods.description: Sets the device friendly name via 'org.rdk.System.setFriendlyName'.

methods.name: GetDeviceSku
methods.description: Retrieves the device SKU from 'org.rdk.System.getSystemVersions'.

methods.name: GetFirmwareVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the firmware version, including API, firmware, OS, and debug info.

methods.name: GetCountryCode
methods.description: Retrieves the country code derived from 'org.rdk.System.getTerritory'.

methods.name: SetCountryCode
methods.description: Sets the country code via 'org.rdk.System.setTerritory'.

methods.name: GetTimeZone
methods.description: Retrieves the system timezone via 'org.rdk.System.getTimeZoneDST'.

methods.name: SetTimeZone
methods.description: Sets the system timezone via 'org.rdk.System.setTimeZoneDST'.

methods.name: GetSecondScreenFriendlyName
methods.description: Alias for GetDeviceName.

methods.name: GetScreenResolution
methods.description: Retrieves current screen resolution using 'DisplaySettings.getCurrentResolution'.

methods.name: GetVideoResolution
methods.description: Infers video resolution based on screen resolution, with fallback defaults.

methods.name: GetHdcp
methods.description: Retrieves HDCP status via 'HdcpProfile.getHDCPStatus'.

methods.name: GetHdr
methods.description: Retrieves HDR capabilities via 'DisplaySettings.getTVHDRCapabilities'.

methods.name: GetAudio
methods.description: Retrieves supported audio formats and sets flags accordingly.

methods.name: EmitOnVideoResolutionChanged
methods.description: Emits event when video resolution changes.

methods.name: EmitOnScreenResolutionChanged
methods.description: Emits event when screen resolution changes.

methods.name: EmitOnHdcpChanged
methods.description: Emits event when HDCP status changes.

methods.name: EmitOnHdrChanged
methods.description: Emits event when HDR capabilities change.

methods.name: EmitOnNameChanged
methods.description: Emits event when device name changes.

methods.name: EmitOnAudioChanged
methods.description: Emits event when supported audio formats change.

methods.name: HandleEvent
methods.description: Handles app subscription/unsubscription to system events.
